harnesses.name: Grok

effort.evidence: grok --help (demo box, 2026-09-01, grok 1.0.13); enum from live invalid-value reject in lead research (xhigh, high, medium, low)

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: grok --help (demo box, grok 1.0.13) has -m/--model <MODEL> 'Model ID to use' with no enumeration; `grok models --help` says 'List available models and exit' and offers --leader-socket <PATH>; where the list comes from is not stated, and Convoy does not call it

cloud.evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: grok --help (demo box, grok 1.0.13) names remote sessions only on the resume path: `--restore-code  Restore the original session's repository snapshot when resuming. Remote sessions require --worktree (never checks out into the current directory)`; `-w, --worktree ... With --resume of a remote session, pass --restore-code to apply the snapshot codebase`. No option creates or attaches a remote session from this CLI, and Convoy has never resumed one

harnesses.name: Claude Code

effort.evidence: claude --help (demo box, 2026-09-01) lists low|medium|high|xhigh|max; vendor docs also name ultracode, which is not in --help and is never emitted by Convoy

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: claude --help (demo box, 2.1.260) --model <model> takes 'an alias for the latest model ... or a model's full name'; examples, not a closed list

cloud.evidence: claude --help (demo box, 2.1.260, 2026-09-04): `--cloud [description|session_id|url]  Create a cloud session with the given description, or attach to an existing one by session ID or claude.ai/code URL`; also `--environment <environment_id>  Create a new cloud session that runs on the given self-hosted environment (ccpool_...)`. --cloud is an option of the interactive claude command, not a task subcommand; attach by id/url is stated, whether the create path stays attached is not

harnesses.name: Codex
harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: codex --help (demo box, codex-cli 0.153.0) -m/--model <MODEL> 'Model the agent should use'; no enumeration

cloud.evidence: codex --help (demo box, codex-cli 0.153.0, 2026-09-04): `cloud  [EXPERIMENTAL] Browse tasks from Codex Cloud and apply changes locally`; codex cloud --help lists `codex cloud exec` as `exec  Submit a new Codex Cloud task without launching the TUI`, plus status, list, apply, diff. A submitted task, not an interactive session. `--remote <ADDR>  Connect the TUI to a remote app server endpoint` is a self-hosted app server, not Codex Cloud

harnesses.name: Antigravity (CLI)

effort.evidence: agy --help (demo box, 2026-09-01): --effort low|medium|high; resume is --conversation <ID>, there is no --resume flag

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: agy --help (demo box, 1.1.22) --model 'Model for the current CLI session'; `agy models` is described only as 'List available models'; where the list comes from is not stated, and Convoy does not call it

cloud.evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: agy --help (demo box, 1.1.22) has no line matching cloud or remote; nothing to quote, and absence in --help is not proof the product lacks a surface

harnesses.name: Hermes

effort.evidence: hermes --help (demo box, 2026-09-01): --resume SESSION / -r verified; effort belongs to the driven model

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: hermes --help (demo box, v0.18.2) -m/--model MODEL 'Model override for this invocation (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6)'; provider/model is free-form, no closed list

cloud.evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: hermes --help (demo box, v0.18.2) matches only `whatsapp-cloud  Set up WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration` and `serve  Start the Hermes backend server (headless; powers the desktop app and remote backends)`; neither is a cloud agent session

harnesses.name: Pi

effort.evidence: pi --help (demo box, 2026-09-01): --thinking <level> for the driven model; model pattern also accepts :<thinking>. --resume is a session picker; direct-id resume unverified

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: pi --help (demo box, 0.80.6) --model <pattern> 'Model pattern or ID (supports provider/id and optional :<thinking>)'; a pattern is not a closed list; --list-models [search] is described only as 'List available models (with optional fuzzy search)'; where the list comes from is not stated, and Convoy does not call it

cloud.evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: pi --help (demo box, 0.80.6) matches only the CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY / CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID / CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_ID provider env vars; a model provider, not a cloud session
